ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the figure, points A, B, and C are all on the circle $\odot O$, and point C is on the major arc corresponding to chord AB. If $\angle AOB=72^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle ACB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Since the central angle $\angle AOB$ and the inscribed angle $\angle ACB$ both subtend the arc $\overset{\frown}{AB}$, \\
therefore $\angle ACB = \frac{1}{2}\angle AOB = \frac{1}{2} \times 72^\circ = \boxed{36^\circ}$

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle, with O marked inside the circle as the center, and A, B, C all on the circumference; A and B are located below the circle, and C is located on the right side slightly above; line segments OA and OB form the central angle ∠AOB, and line segments CA and CB form the inscribed angle ∠ACB. C is on the larger arc from A to B, so ∠ACB intercepts the minor arc AB that does not contain C. Reasoning: Given ∠AOB=72°, the measure of the minor arc AB subtended by the central angle is 72°.
